ukberi-tibyan:1-10.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا (١) وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا (٢) وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا (٣) وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا (٤) وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا (٥) وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا (٦) وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا (٧) فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا (٨) قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا (٩) وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ دَسَّاهَا (١٠)).
The first wāw is for the oath, and what follows it is conjunction. (إِذْ) is governed by the [verb of the] oath [Translator's note: so in the printed text; the verses have «إِذَا»]; and the answer of the oath is (قَدْ أَفْلَحَ), and the lām was omitted because of the length of the speech.
(مَا) in the three places is in the sense of «مَنْ» (who); it is also said that it is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). (دَسَّاهَا): its origin is «دَسَّسَهَا»; the last sīn was changed to alif because of the multitude of identical letters.

ukberi-tibyan:11-12.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَاهَا (١١) إِذِ انْبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا (١٢)).
«الطَّغْوَى» is on the pattern «فَعْلَى» from «الطُّغْيَانُ» (transgression), and the wāw is substituted for a yāʾ, like «التَّقْوَى». Whoever says «طَغَوْتُ», the wāw is original in his view. (إِذْ) is an adverb (ẓarf) for «كَذَّبَتْ» or for «طَغْوَى».

ukberi-tibyan:13-13.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا (١٣)).
(نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ) is accusative (manṣūb) with the sense of «احْذَرُوا» (beware).

ukberi-tibyan:15-15.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا (١٥)).
(وَلَا يَخَافُ): with the wāw, the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); i.e. he did that while not fearing.
It has been read with fāʾ, on the basis that it is for conjunction without delay; and the pronoun in «سَوَّاهَا» and «عُقْبَاهَا» is for the punishment. And Allah knows best.
